q.line: And in attempts to understand a thing so simple and so huge
stanza: At the way the earth was abused
By the men who learned how to forge her beauty into power
And they struggled to protect her from them
By the magnitude of her fury in the final hour
And when the sand was gone and the time arrived
In the naked dawn only a few survived
And in attempts to understand a thing so simple and so huge
Believed that they were meant to live after the deluge

q.line: Riots are tiny though, systems are huge
q.linePrev: I am quiet, feeling the onset of riot
q.lineNext: Traffic keeps moving, proving there's nothing to do
